import pytest
from tomlkit import parse
from tomlkit.exceptions import KeyAlreadyPresent, TOMLKitError


def test_value_then_table_split_redefinition_raises_at_parse() -> None:
    """
    Test that an out-of-order value-vs-table redefinition
    raises KeyAlreadyPresent at parse time.
    """
    src = '[a]\nb = true\n[zz]\n[a.b]\nc = 1\n'
    with pytest.raises(KeyAlreadyPresent):
        parse(src)


def test_dotted_key_then_table_split_redefinition_raises_at_parse() -> None:
    """
    Test that an out-of-order dotted-key-vs-table redefinition
    raises KeyAlreadyPresent at parse time.
    """
    src = '[a]\nb.c = 1\n[zz]\nq = 9\n[a.b]\nd = 2\n'
    with pytest.raises(KeyAlreadyPresent):
        parse(src)
